decisions.subject: offline Ed25519 key source mode
decisions.recommended_option: prefer an existing qualifying owner-controlled offline Ed25519 key when complete provenance, custody, rotation, and public-key evidence can be supplied; otherwise select a new offline ceremony that requires its own later exact authorization
evidence: ADR-0066 permits only an owner-selected existing offline key or a separately authorized new offline ceremony.
The private key is prohibited from the stand and repository under every option.
The current P4-K preparation leaves the source mode null.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; the signer authenticates authorization artifacts and cannot select treatments, platform freeze values, calibration inputs, or outcomes
decisions.compatibility_effect: the selected public-key bytes, SHA-256 fingerprint, custody lineage, and rotation identity become authorization compatibility identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before any key read, generation, import, copy, fingerprint calculation, public-key artifact construction, or signing action
decisions.supersession_rule: a source-mode, private-key, public-key, custody, or rotation change requires new prospective acceptance, new evidence, and new signatures; prior artifacts remain immutable

decisions.subject: literal offline custody domain, custodian, and later public-artifact source path
decisions.recommended_option: require the owner to supply a literal non-stand custody-domain ID and custodian-principal ID before any key action; select the create-exclusive absolute public allowed-signers source path only after the public artifact is authorized and constructed
evidence: ADR-0066 requires an owner-selected off-stand custody domain and custodian.
ADR-0070 requires off-stand canonical construction and independent review.
No repository or stand path may be inferred as private-key custody.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; custody preserves signing authority and evidence separation only
decisions.compatibility_effect: custody-domain ID, custodian ID, public-artifact path, create-exclusive policy, and custody receipts become evidence identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before P4-K acquisition authorization or public allowed-signers artifact creation
decisions.supersession_rule: any domain, custodian, path, access, retention, backup, or recovery-policy change requires prospective supersession and a new unused artifact identity

decisions.subject: split P4-K acquisition/construction from independent review and later installation
decisions.recommended_option: use one source-mode-specific P4-K-A authorization for exactly one offline acquisition/construction attempt, stop with append-only evidence, then require a distinct P4-K-R review before any setup, installation, authorization signing, or Q15 action
evidence: ADR-0070 requires independent SHA-256 and fingerprint verification.
The current P4-K preparation has no commands, key bytes, hashes, or authorization.
Splitting acquisition from review prevents self-attested trust-anchor evidence.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; the graph creates and reviews public authorization evidence only
decisions.compatibility_effect: gate split, source-mode-specific commands, one-attempt rule, artifact IDs, raw public bytes, canonical allowed-signers bytes, hashes, fingerprint, and review receipt become transaction identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before any P4-K-A or P4-K-R authorization template can be issued
decisions.supersession_rule: any graph, command, tool, retry, canonicalization, review, or retention change requires a new decision and prospective authorization; partial artifacts are retained

decisions.subject: P4-K named authority, validity, signature, and distinct-review policy
decisions.recommended_option: extend the accepted Q15-R governance profile to P4-K: cpu-prefetch-q15-operator, exact nonrenewable 1800-second UTC window, JCS-I64-v1, OpenSSH SSHSIG Ed25519/SHA-512, and a distinct cpu-prefetch-q15-auditor review; actual UTC instants and hashes remain later evidence
evidence: ADR-0058 freezes the four logical role IDs and forbids role collapse.
ADR-0060 freezes the canonical SSHSIG issuance boundary.
ADR-0074 accepts this profile for P4-R-I/P4-R-C but does not silently extend it to P4-K.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; this constrains who may authorize one offline evidence action and for how long
decisions.compatibility_effect: authority principal, canonicalization, signature profile, validity duration, issued/expiry instants, authorization hash, detached-signature hash, and independent-review hash become transaction identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before signing or issuing a future P4-K-A or P4-K-R authorization
decisions.supersession_rule: any principal, duration, canonicalization, scheme, signer, or review-policy change requires a new decision, new unsigned authorization bytes, and prospective acceptance

proposed_gate_graph.scope: select D-076 through D-079 and authorize only acceptance, ADR, and still-unissued successor-template preparation
one future source-mode-specific offline key/public-artifact acquisition and canonical allowed-signers construction action
future distinct independent verification of exact public bytes, SHA-256 values, fingerprint, custody, and canonical allowed-signers artifact
later stand setup and allowed-signers installation after accepted P4-K review evidence

minimum_owner_inputs_before_exact_accept.question: Select the D-076 key source mode.
Provide the literal non-stand custody-domain ID and custodian-principal ID; do not provide private-key bytes or secrets.
Accept or revise the recommended D-078 split acquisition/review graph and D-079 authority/validity profile.
